integrity: An explicit rational piecewise derivation proves the three zeros; a standalone standard-library exact-rational checker independently replays the overflow recurrences. Primary observational studies serve as motivation, not empirical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic two-pulse, two-roof finite-capacity model with constructed parameters; no calibration, stochastic rainfall law, or statement about discharge peaks. Only the minimality of two roof types for the exhibited three-switch behavior is proved, not a maximum number for arbitrary parallel roof designs.
title: Three exact storm-order reversals across two heterogeneous retention roofs
